user.title: Govee BLE Air Purifier
user.description: Choose a recently seen purifier whose BLE name contains H712 followed by one ASCII letter or digit (case-insensitive), or enter its BLE address manually. Setup will disclose the detected model's verification level before using a profile that is not fully verified.

data_description.address: Only required when Recently seen purifier is set to Enter address manually.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add discovered Govee air purifier
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered {name}. Continue to review its support level and settings. Before setup finishes, Home Assistant will connect and verify the purifier using read-only status requests.

support_read_verified.title: Limited write verification
support_read_verified.description: The {model} profile has been physically verified for connection, encrypted handshake, polling, and recovery. State-changing commands have not yet been physically verified. Continue only if you accept that controls may not behave as expected.

support_experimental.title: Experimental model support
support_experimental.description: The {model} has a model-specific experimental profile based on protocol evidence, but it has not completed physical verification. Continue only if you accept that state reporting, controls, or exposed features may not behave as expected.

support_fallback.title: Unverified family fallback
support_fallback.description: The {model} does not have a model-specific profile. It will use the limited H712-family fallback, which may fail or expose controls and features that do not match the device. Continue only if you accept this risk.

polling.title: Polling
polling.description: Configure how often Home Assistant reads this purifier. The default is selected for the detected model.

data_description.polling_interval: How often Home Assistant actively connects over BLE to read core purifier state. Supported models may reconcile night-light state on a separate profile-defined schedule.
data_description.share_bluetooth_connection: Leave off to retain a dedicated connection for faster controls. Turn on for at least two purifiers when your Bluetooth adapter or proxy does not have enough GATT connection slots; opted-in purifiers share one prioritized connection lane.

custom_auto.title: Five Air Quality Steps
custom_auto.description: Configure increase confirmation and the four boundaries between Excellent, Good, Fair, Bad, and Poor. Positive confirmation delays require a second valid reading; 0 seconds reacts to the first reading. Returns to cleaner levels happen only after the configured delay. Activate these rules with the device's Custom Auto switch.

data.custom_auto_delay_20: Good to Excellent: time at or below
data.custom_auto_delay_40: Fair to Good: time at or below
data.custom_auto_delay_60: Bad to Fair: time at or below
data.custom_auto_delay_80: Poor to Bad: time at or below

data_description.custom_auto_confirmation_delay: Wait this many seconds before requesting a confirming PM2.5 reading. Set to 0 to increase immediately from the first valid reading.

excellent_good.name: Excellent to Good (20% / 40%)
excellent_good.description: Controls the boundary between Excellent air at 20% and Good air at 40%.

data.custom_auto_delay_20: Time at or below before returning

good_fair.name: Good to Fair (40% / 60%)
good_fair.description: Controls the boundary between Good air at 40% and Fair air at 60%.

data.custom_auto_delay_40: Time at or below before returning

fair_bad.name: Fair to Bad (60% / 80%)
fair_bad.description: Controls the boundary between Fair air at 60% and Bad air at 80%.

data.custom_auto_delay_60: Time at or below before returning

bad_poor.name: Bad to Poor (80% / 100%)
bad_poor.description: Controls the boundary between Bad air at 80% and Poor air at 100%.

data.custom_auto_delay_80: Time at or below before returning

probe.title: Could not verify purifier
probe.description: Home Assistant could not complete the read-only connection check for {model}. Make sure the purifier is nearby, close the Govee app, and select Submit to retry. No power, fan, or light setting is changed by this check.

error.address_required: Enter a BLE address or choose a recently seen purifier.
error.device_not_found: Home Assistant has not seen this BLE address advertise as a Govee H712-family purifier. Move the purifier closer, wake it, and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the purifier or complete its protocol handshake. Move it closer, close the Govee app, and try again.
error.invalid_response: The purifier connected but did not return valid status data for this model profile.
error.probe_cleanup_failed: The purifier responded, but Home Assistant could not finish closing the temporary setup connection. Wait a moment and try again.
error.probe_timeout: The purifier did not complete the read-only setup check in time. Move it closer, close the Govee app, and try again.
error.invalid_address: Enter a complete Bluetooth MAC address or platform UUID.
error.unsupported_device: The selected BLE device is not a recognized Govee H712-family air purifier.
error.invalid_custom_auto_value: Enter whole numbers within the displayed ranges.
error.thresholds_not_ascending: Air-quality boundaries must rise from Excellent through Poor.

abort.already_configured: This air purifier is already configured.
abort.not_connectable: This purifier was seen by a Bluetooth scanner that cannot make outgoing connections. Move it within range of a connectable adapter or Bluetooth proxy.
abort.not_supported: This BLE device is not a recognized Govee H712-family air purifier.
abort.unknown: Setup state was lost. Start setup again.
